A family kitchen since 2009

Royal Spice started as a six-table takeaway run by the Ahmed family, and the recipes haven’t changed since day one — because they didn’t need to. Our spices are ground in-house every week, the marinades rest overnight, and every naan is rolled and baked to order in the clay tandoor you can see from the counter.

No shortcuts and no heat lamps: your curry is cooked when you order it, which is why regulars from Finnieston to Partick are happy to wait the extra five minutes.
